verdicts: Packaged application starts with text and image monitoring off
Explicit opt-in captures real Chrome text and skips the pre-existing clipboard slot
Real clipboard repeat is suppressed and a synthetic credential-shaped string is skipped
Windows receives and preserves a real Chrome PNG clipboard write
Pause prevents capture and resume accepts the next real clipboard write
Windows captures copied text from a separate Notepad window
Global shortcut opens quick capture when sent from the Chrome window
Window close hides Catch while it remains running in the tray
Explicit Electron application quit completes with the window hidden
Restart preserves text and image and resets monitoring to off
